questions.markdown:
Distinguish between aligned and non-aligned data in ARM memory space. Show the data transfer of the following cases with appropriate figures and indicate the number of memory cycle times it takes for data transfer.

Assume that $R1 = 0x40000000$ and $R2 = 0x4598F31E$.

```armasm
MOV R3, 3
UP  STR R2, [R1], #1
    SUBS R3, #1
    BNE UP
```

Analyse the following program and write the contents of register $R6$, $R7$ and $R8$.

```armasm
AREA mycode, CODE, READONLY
ENTRY
    LDR R0, =Value1
    LDR R1, =Value2
    BL JMP
    LDR R0, =Result
    STR R7, [R0], #4
    STR R8, [R0], #4
    STR R6, [R0], #4
    B STOP

JMP LDR R2, [R0]
    LDR R3, [R0, #4]
    LDR R4, [R1]
    LDR R5, [R1, #4]
    ADDS R7, R3, R5
    UMULL R6, R8, R2, R4
    BX LR

STOP B STOP

Value1 DCD 0x12A2E640, 0xF2100123
Value2 DCD 0x001019BF, 0x40023F51

AREA mydata, DATA, READWRITE
Result DCD 0
END
```

Develop an Embedded C program to display "LIFE" in the seven-segment display (SSD) units interfaced with LPC 1768. Assume that the eight segments of all the SSD units are connected to the port pins $P0.4$ to $P0.11$ and the SSD units can be enabled one by one using the port pins $P1.23$ to $P1.26$.

ii) Configure port pins $P1.14$ to $P1.18$ as input and $P1.22$ to $P1.30$ as output.
